headline: Laxmi Organic Industries files SEBI Takeover Regulation disclosure under Regulation 31(4)
sum: Laxmi Organic Industries Limited has filed a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, triggering public reporting of a substantial shareholding change or acquisition event.
detail: The disclosure was submitted to NSE in compliance with SEBI takeover framework requirements. Regulation 31(4) mandates reporting when acquirers cross specified shareholding thresholds. The filing triggers investor disclosures and may activate open offer requirements if the acquisition brings a person above the 26% or 50% threshold. Exact acquisition details (acquirer identity, shares/value, conditions) are contained in the formal disclosure document.
